title: The positive attributes of Allah (as-sifat ath-thubutiyyah)
intro: The eight attributes of Allah’s perfection – and the blessings He gave us.

learn.html: As-sifat ath-thubutiyyah are the attributes of Allah’s perfection, with which He, the Most High, described Himself. There are eight of them:

items: Hayah – Allah lives His eternal life. It has no beginning and no end.
‘Ilm – Allah knows everything. His knowledge covers everything.
Sam‘ – Allah hears everything. His hearing covers everything.
Basar – Allah sees everything. His sight covers everything.
Iradah – Allah does everything by His will. He does not depend on anyone.
Qudrah – Allah is All-Powerful. His power covers everything.
Kalam – Allah speaks with His divine speech. His speech is perfect.
Takwin – Allah creates, keeps and ends everything. His decisions are final.

learn.html: Through these attributes we believe that Allah’s qualities are perfect. Allah (SWT) gave people qualities with the same names – but ours are limited. For example, ‘Ilm: Allah knows everything, but a person’s knowledge is limited.

learn.title: ⭐ Remember
learn.html: Each of Allah’s attributes is mentioned in the Qur’an. People must not describe Him in any other way than the way He described Himself.
Allah gave us many blessings: life, knowledge, hearing, sight, will, strength, speech and a mind. We thank Allah for them by saying:

practice.title: Match the attribute and its meaning
Allah or people?
practice.prompt: Is this about Allah’s perfect attributes, or about people’s limited ones?

items.text: Learns a little more each day
Needs glasses to see far away
Gets tired and needs to sleep

questions.q: How many attributes of Allah’s perfection are there?

options: Allah creates, keeps and ends everything

questions.q: How is our knowledge different from Allah’s knowledge?
options: Ours is limited, His covers everything

questions.q: How do we thank Allah for His blessings?

practice.title: Review and answer
prompts: 💭 Is this list of blessings that Allah gave us complete? What else would you add?
✏️ From the list of blessings, write down the ones you have. Then swap with the friend next to you.
🤲 Thank Allah for your blessings together: Al-hamdu lillah!
✏️ In your notebook, draw ALLAH (SWT) in a box with the 14 attributes – 6 + 8 – underneath.
